rules.statement: RM-1 dwelling-unit capacity is set by a tiered minimum lot area per dwelling unit: 360 sq ft per unit for the first 1,440 sq ft of lot area, and 480 sq ft per unit for lot area above 1,440 sq ft; fractional units round down.
rules.codeSection: The Philadelphia Code § 14-701, Table 14-701-2, note [1] (density row)
rules.verbatimQuote: Notes p.48 — '[1] In the RM-1 district, the minimum lot area required per dwelling unit is as follows, provided that, whenever the calculation of permitted number of dwelling units results in a fraction of a dwelling unit, then the number of permitted dwelling units shall be rounded down to the nearest whole number: a. A minimum 360 sq. ft. of lot area is required per dwelling unit for the first 1,440 sq. ft. of lot area. b. A minimum of 480 sq. ft. of lot area is required per dwelling unit for the lot area in excess of 1,440 sq. ft.'
rules.notes: Deliberately NOT applied to compute a unit count in this benchmark — that computation belongs to the future solver with explicit assumptions (existing-use retention, occupied-area, height, mission constraints).

rules.statement: Maximum occupied area in RM-1 is 75% of lot area for intermediate lots and 80% for corner lots; buildings on lots less than 45 ft in depth are exempt from the maximum occupied area requirement.

rules.notes: Value records the intermediate-lot figure; corner-lot value is 80. Whether this parcel is an intermediate or corner lot (i.e., whether it fronts only Roosevelt Blvd or also a side street) must be determined geometrically against the parcel ring and street centerlines — solver question.

rules.statement: RM-1 front setback is context-based: the front facade placement follows the immediately adjacent / blockface buildings per notes [5] and [6]; there is no fixed numeric minimum in the guide's table.
rules.verbatimQuote: 'Min. Front Setback ... Based on adjacent [5,6]'; note [6]: 'On any given street, the distance between the front facade and the front lot line shall be no greater than the distance between the front facade and the front lot line of the principal building on the immediately adjacent lot on such street with the greater distance... and shall be no less than the distance between the front facade and the front lot line of the principal building on the immediately adjacent lot on such street with the lesser distance...'
